main.bork:9:13: where clauses inside function types are not supported yet
main.bork:13:25: where clauses on the methods of classes and instances are not supported yet
main.bork:19:25: where clauses on the parameters of instance methods are not supported (an instance for a constrained type assumes its constraints)
main.bork:23:11: values.PositiveInt is a constrained type (where values.Positive), and constrained types on a lambda's parameters are not supported yet, so the fact would not be checked
